title: Poster designer portfolio with reproducible work (house style supplied)

brief.role: Cultural-sector program director deciding whether to shortlist a poster designer for a season campaign
brief.job: Inspect the actual work at evaluative scale, understand the judgment behind it, and decide to start a conversation.
brief.consequence: Shortlisting on decoration alone wastes a commissioning cycle; passing on real judgment loses the season's strongest option.
facts: Ilse Marden is an independent poster designer. Contact is a form on this page; no response time is promised.
The work may be reproduced on this page as HTML/CSS interpretations at display scale, faithful to the specs below. No photography of the posters exists and none may be simulated.

Poster 1 — 'Winter Chamber Series' (2025), for the Fenwick Concert Hall: near-black ground #14161a, single warm accent #d98e32, a tall condensed sans wordmark set vertically along the left edge, concert dates set in a small tabular column bottom-right. The commissioning constraint: legible at 40 meters and as an A6 flyer.

Poster 2 — 'Open Archive Week' (2024), for the city records office: paper ground #efe9dc, two inks only (#1f3a5f, #c0392b), the title set as three stacked lines filling the full width, an isometric grid of thin rules occupying the lower half representing shelving. Constraint: reproducible on a risograph.

Poster 3 — 'Night Swimming' (2024), for the municipal pools' late hours: deep blue ground #0c2340, the title set in a rounded slab serif curving along a single arc, seven small white circles descending the right side. Constraint: readable from a moving tram.

Supplied outcomes: the Winter Chamber Series poster was reprinted twice due to demand; Open Archive Week attendance is not supplied; Night Swimming ran for one season. No client quotes, awards, or press exist.
Ilse's stated method, quoted with permission: 'One move per poster. If the second idea survives, the first one wasn't strong enough.'

House style, supplied by the client's brand system and binding like any other fact: light warm neutral ground; 1 accent hue drawn from: mustard; interface type is a grotesque sans set in all caps labels; display type differs from interface type; corners slightly rounded; borders none; shadows none; overall density airy; standard chrome includes: filter pills, view toggle, top nav bar, logo mark, eyebrow label, text link with arrow, tag label, clock/status readout; imagery register: photography; backgrounds flat.

required_interactions: Inspect a poster at evaluative scale
Move from a poster to the judgment behind it (constraint and method)
Reach and submit the contact form with validation
required_states: poster reproductions rendered from the supplied specs
contact form success without delivery promises
acceptance_checks: Each reproduction follows its supplied spec (grounds, accents, composition moves) without invented imagery, photography simulation, or added award/press claims.
The work is inspectable at a scale that permits evaluation and carries its constraint beside it.
Supplied outcomes appear verbatim in weight-appropriate positions; unsupplied outcomes are not implied.
The page reads as an authored portfolio, not a template: one visual system, hierarchy that makes the strongest work primary.
The build stays within the supplied house style register; the assigned direction expresses itself only within it.
